findings.title: Uncapped liability for data protection incidents
findings.deviation: Data protection is carved out from the aggregate liability cap, leaving liability for data incidents uncapped.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited exposure to financial damages in the event of a data protection incident.
findings.quote: Each party's aggregate liability capped at total fees, except for breach of confidentiality, data protection or fraud.
findings.counterPosition: Subject data protection liability to a separate super-cap (such as 2x total fees) rather than leaving it uncapped.

fine.note: Liquidated damages clause matches standard rate of 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the affected milestone fee for supplier-caused delays.
IP ownership structure matches standard where bank-specific deliverables vest upon payment while AtliQ retains background tools and methodologies.
No indemnity obligations are imposed on AtliQ.
Payment term of 45 days is within acceptable negotiated limits.
Governing law and arbitration seat in Pune match standard for AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd.
